```yaml
name: Lint ObjC New Usage

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint-objc-new:
    name: Check for [ClassName new] usage
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed Objective-C files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          filter: '\.(m|mm|h)$'
          format: 'space-delimited'

      - name: Check for [ClassName new] pattern
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed-files.outputs.added != ''
        run: |
          # Combine modified and added files
          FILES="${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.modified }} ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added }}"
          
          FOUND_VIOLATIONS=0
          
          for FILE in $FILES; do
            if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
              # Search for pattern: [SomeClass new]
              # We look for word boundary before class name, then ' new]'
              # Using grep with extended regex
              if grep -E '\[[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s+new\]' "$FILE"; then
                echo "::error file=$FILE::Found usage of [ClassName new]. Please use [[ClassName alloc] init] instead."
                FOUND_VIOLATIONS=1
              fi
            fi
          done
          
          if [ $FOUND_VIOLATIONS -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Found violations of ObjC new usage convention."
            echo "Please replace [ClassName new] with [[ClassName alloc] init]."
            echo "See AGENTS.md for more details."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No violations found."
          fi
```
